Counted by this site's own counter, no identities. WoW Forever launches 4 November 2026; until then these are builds for the beta trees, and the count starts again when a patch changes them.

Builds within a few points of each other count as one family, shown by its most used member. The rows and the spec split come from the 9,789 Mage builds with 41 or more points planned here since the Oct 20 hotfixes to build 70425, ranked by what people did with each family since then: a share or a save weighs 5, a link open 3, making the build 2 and a view 1. The shared, saved and opened counts run from 13 Sep, before the beta: a row's share is its family's shares, saves and link opens over every Mage build's (3,079 shares, 7,085 saves, 68,949 link opens since 13 Sep), so a row can hold a larger share than one ranked above it.

Since 13 Sep, 82,430 Mage builds were made, shared, saved or opened here and 16,563 of them have all 51 points, those today's trees no longer allow included; this list counts the 9,789 with 41 or more points that today's trees allow, since the Oct 20 hotfixes to build 70425.

No build has 3 PvP tags on two days yet (52 so far). In the Mage calculator, tap PvP in the "What's it for?" row on a build you made for PvP.

Players tag a build Leveling, PvE or PvP in the "What's it for?" row of the Mage calculator; a tag counts once they have saved or shared that build, one a day each. A build is listed with 3 tags on two days, named only once two or more people used it on the same day, and only for what at least half as many of its tags say as its most said purpose. Tank, healer or DPS is read from the talents. Tags say what players use a build for, not how strong it is.

This is a count of what people plan on this site, not a tier list. When a beta build moves, adds, removes or renames a Mage talent or changes what it needs first, the count starts again from the day after that build and shows once 1,000 builds with 41 or more points are made on the new trees, as it did after the Oct 20 hotfixes to build 70425.

Questions

Which Mage spec do people build most in WoW Forever?
3,789 of the 9,789 Mage builds with 41 or more points planned here (39%) lead in Frost, 3,143 in Fire and 2,857 in Arcane, counted since the Oct 20 hotfixes to build 70425. Weighted by what people did with each build (made, viewed, opened by link, shared or saved), Frost has 38%, Arcane 32% and Fire 30%. At the level 30 cap the most made 21-point build also leads in Frost. 49.5% of the Mage leveling orders people recorded lead in Frost.
What is the most popular Mage build at level 30, the beta cap?
Frost 0/0/21: 3.3% of the 329 level 30 Mage builds counted between 1 and 16 Oct 2026 (11 people-days), maxing Ice Shards, Frostbite, Ice Lance, Ice Block and Shatter. Since this count, Piercing Ice was taken out of the trees.
What is the most popular Mage build at level 60?
Arcane Mage 47/4/0, ranked first by what people did with each build since the Oct 20 hotfixes (a share or a save weighs 5, a link open 3, making the build 2, a view 1). It holds 1.6% of every Mage share, save and link open counted here since 13 Sep (shared 60, saved 168, opened 1,033).
Which Mage talents are taken most and least?
Most taken: Missile Barrage (72%), Elemental Precision (70%) and Ice Lance (63%). Least taken: Improved Fire Ward (1%), Improved Flamestrike (7%) and Arcane Shielding (9%). The percentages are the share of Mage builds with 41 or more points that have at least one point in the talent, each build counted once.
Which Mage build is for raids, PvP or dungeons?
The counter records the builds people plan, not what they plan them for, so no build here is marked raid, PvP or dungeon. The 5 most used builds above come from all 9,789 Mage builds with 41 or more points planned here since the Oct 20 hotfixes to build 70425. What the beta files say for each use: Arcane Brilliance reaches the target's party and raid (in Classic, the party), Improved Scorch raises the Fire damage you deal to the target by 3% a stack (Classic's text: the Fire damage dealt to your target) and Improved Counterspell always silences, 2 seconds at rank 1 and 4 at rank 2 (Classic's: a 50% chance of 4 seconds).
Will these Mage builds change at launch?
The count restarts when a patch changes the talents. This list counts since the Oct 20 hotfixes to build 70425 and is recounted a few times a day. The game launches 4 November 2026.
Is this a Mage tier list?
No. The builds are ranked by what people did with them on this site (shared, saved, opened by link, made or viewed), not by how strong they are.
Where do these Mage build numbers come from?
From this site's own counter, which keeps counts only and no identities: every Mage build planned in the calculator, and how often each was shared, saved or opened by link. Builds within a few points of each other count as one family, shown by its most used member, and every spec gets at least one row. The list is rebuilt a few times a day, last on 29 Oct 2026.
